description: CRIT-203's passThreshold text states verbatim: "the tool's stdout carries NOTE_LIVE_URL for https://note.com/anicca123/n/n39ef09f828f7 and a NOTE_LIVE_CLICKED: 投稿する|更新する marker" -- grouping both markers as stdout output. The actual implementation prints NOTE_LIVE_URL and NOTE_LIVE_SCREENSHOT to stdout but prints NOTE_LIVE_CLICKED to stderr (file=sys.stderr). The tool's own docstring INTERFACE section (lines 63-67) correctly documents this split (only NOTE_LIVE_URL/NOTE_LIVE_SCREENSHOT are listed under 'stdout on success'), so the code is internally consistent with its own docs -- the discrepancy is only against the contract's literal wording. This is non-blocking in practice because tests/test-prop22b-live-publish-real-click.sh captures the tool's combined output via `2>&1` before grepping for NOTE_LIVE_CLICKED (line 72: `OUT="$(... 2>&1)"`), so the passThreshold's actual gating test genuinely exercises and passes this assertion regardless of which stream the marker lands on. Flagged for precision only -- no safety, fail-closed, or real-publish-correctness guarantee is affected by this channel choice.
